EBMM - Non-Tariff Barrier Reporting & Case Management

Exporters running into non-tariff barriers — border delays, permit issues, unfair inspections — had no single place to
report them, and officials had no structured way to triage, escalate and resolve each case against service-level targets.
I built the entire web platform and am building the companion Android app. The Jakarta EE backend was built by a teammate.

Public, exporter, partner and internal/admin portals are served from one codebase. Each
URL prefix resolves its own layout, Keycloak realm and API base URL, so the four audiences never share a session.

Triage, action plans, milestones, escalation, closure and SLA tracking — every screen only
offers the actions the signed-in role is allowed to take.

Reference-data admin pages are generated from configuration objects instead of being
hand-written one by one.

Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, structured after Google's Now in Android sample.
Exporters can draft reports with attachments offline; drafts queue in Room and sync when the network returns. Auth uses
AppAuth with PKCE and the auth state is encrypted with Tink.
Nuxt 4, Nuxt UI, Pinia, i18n, Tailwind 4
Keycloak with separate admin, partner and public realms
Jakarta EE 11 on WildFly (JAX-RS, JPA, JMS), ~10 Maven modules
Kotlin, Compose, Hilt, Room, Retrofit, AppAuth
separate test, UAT and production builds, following the government brand manual

The web platform is live in production as the country's official reporting channel for non-tariff barriers. The Android
app is in active development.

National system for exporters to report non-tariff trade barriers and for officials to manage each case through triage, action plans, milestones, escalation and closure, tracked against SLAs. The web app serves four portals (public, exporter, partner, internal) from one codebase, each with its own layout, Keycloak realm and role-scoped actions. A companion native Android app (in progress) lets exporters draft reports with attachments offline and sync them later.
